CustomField.description: Set when TeamsSwarmController.installBotAppBestEffort fails to install the interactive-card bot into a chat swarm (e.g. Teams_Bot_Config__mdt not filled in, or the Named Credential/app catalog upload from README.md section 6 isn't done yet). The chat swarm itself still succeeds either way - this is purely diagnostic. Cleared on the next successful install attempt.
CustomField.label: Swarm Bot Install Error
